title: Density-Level Backward Error for Low-NFE Generative Flows
abstract: arXiv:2610.29475v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-NFE generative ODE sampling is constrained not only by solver order, but also by how a fixed budget of network evaluations is distributed along the flow. We develop a density-level backward-error framework that identifies the component of a solver's modified-equation defect that changes the evolving marginal, while excluding solenoidal trajectory distortion that is invisible in Wasserstein tangent geometry. The resulting residual induces a solver-order-aware compute-allocation rule and, through gauge freedom, an objective for selecting numerically favorable velocity representatives of the same density path. This separates our approach from schedule search driven by trajectory or endpoint surrogates and from higher-order solver design. Exact Gaussian and mixture models establish the mechanism, including cases where curvature-based allocation fails and continuum-optimal transport is not discretization-optimal. On a pretrained CIFAR-10

translated_title: 面向低NFE生成流的密度层面后向误差
translated_abstract: 低NFE（网络函数评估次数）生成式ODE采样不仅受求解器阶数的限制，还受固定的网络评估预算如何沿流分布的影响。我们开发了一个密度层面的后向误差框架，该框架能够识别求解器修正方程缺陷中会改变演化边缘分布的分量，同时排除在Wasserstein切几何中不可见的螺线轨迹畸变。所得残差诱导出一种感知求解器阶数的计算分配规则，并借助规范自由度，提供了一个用于从同一密度路径的多个速度代表中选择数值有利者的目标函数。这将我们的方法与由轨迹或端点替代量驱动的调度搜索以及高阶求解器设计区分开来。精确的高斯模型和混合模型确立了该机制，包括基于曲率的分配失效以及连续最优传输并非离散化最优的情形。在预训练的CIFAR-10
tldr: 本文提出密度层面的后向误差框架，分离出真正改变边缘分布的求解器误差分量，从而为低NFE生成流导出感知求解器阶数的计算分配规则以及基于规范自由度的速度场选择目标。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a density-level backward-error framework that isolates the solver error component affecting evolving marginals, yielding a solver-order-aware compute-allocation rule and a gauge-based objective for selecting numerically favorable velocity representatives in low-NFE generative flows.
